title.zh: 将卡维特中学更名为埃米利亚诺·T·蒂罗纳纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of Kawit High School to Emiliano T. Tirona Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of Kawit High School to Emiliano T. Tirona Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Trung học Kawit thành Trường Trung học Tưởng niệm Emiliano T. Tirona
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kawit เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอนุสรณ์ Emiliano T. Tirona
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Menengah Kawit menjadi Sekolah Menengah Memorial Emiliano T. Tirona
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Menengah Kawit kepada Sekolah Menengah Memorial Emiliano T. Tirona

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_838_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In recognition of the distinguished services rendered by Emiliano T. Tirona, Filipino statesman and leader and an illustrious son of the Province of Cavite, the name of Kawit High School is changed to Emiliano T. Tirona Memorial High School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, March 26, 1953.
